displayPattern: Washer display shows SUd (also shown as 5UD, Sd, 5d, SUdS or 5Ud5 on some models)
meaning: Excessive suds error: the washer detected over-sudsing and stops for a short period to let the suds dissipate, then continues the cycle automatically.
causes: Incorrect use of detergent (too much, or a non-HE detergent)
diySteps: Let the washer pause; the cycle continues automatically afterwards, and the code may flash again at the end as a reminder
Next time use less detergent and make sure it is HE detergent
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Samsung says this code does not indicate that service is needed.
sourceTitle: Samsung washing machine information and error codes (Samsung Support)
